title: check-trailers reads a merge commit's KB-Operator and refuses an email there
goal: kbgit.py check-trailers judges the KB-Operator trailer of a merge commit in its range as it does a plain commit's, and refuses an email address there

run:
import os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); C = os.path.join(T, "clone")
shutil.copytree("_tools", os.path.join(C, "_tools"), ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc", "fixtures"))
shutil.copytree(".claude/hooks", os.path.join(C, ".claude", "hooks"))
for f in ("backlog.json", ".gitignore"):
    shutil.copy(f, C)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "notes"))
EM = "jan.kowalski" + chr(64) + "corp-mail.test"
ENV = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("GIT_", "KB_", "CLAUDE"))}
ENV.update(HOME=T, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1", KB_LIVE_DOCS="0", KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite"),
           GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t" + chr(64) + "example.com", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t" + chr(64) + "example.com")
def g(*a):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=C, env=ENV, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
g("init", "-q", "-b", "main"); g("add", "-A"); g("commit", "-qm", "base", "--no-verify")
g("checkout", "-qb", "side"); open(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self", "notes", "a.md"), "w").write("a\n"); g("add", "-A"); g("commit", "-qm", "docs: a", "--no-verify")
g("checkout", "-q", "main"); g("merge", "-q", "--no-ff", "--no-verify", "-m", "merge side\n\nKB-Operator: " + EM, "side")
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(C, "_tools", "kbgit.py"), "check-trailers", "side..HEAD"], cwd=C, env=ENV, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
bad = r.returncode != 0 and "KB-Operator" in r.stdout + r.stderr
print("ok" if bad else "check-trailers accepts an email in a merge commit's KB-Operator"); sys.exit(0 if bad else 1)
